hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; b=$(basename "$f"); case "$b" in design.md|product-behavior.md|schema-spec.md) d=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null && pwd); t=$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$d" ] || [ "$d" != "$t" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"These reference docs live only at repo root (design.md, product-behavior.md, schema-spec.md) per CLAUDE.md. Edit the matching section in the root file instead of creating a new one here.\"}}"; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '(.tool_input.command // empty) + "\u0001" + (.tool_input.cwd // empty)' | { IFS=$'\x01' read -r cmd cwd; [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; case "$cmd" in *design.md*|*product-behavior.md*|*schema-spec.md*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$cmd" in *cp\ *|*mv\ *|*'>'*|*tee*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; for b in design.md product-behavior.md schema-spec.md; do case "$cmd" in *"$b"*) target="$b" ;; esac; done; path=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE '(^|[^>])>{1,2}[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];|&]+' | tail -1 | sed -E 's/^.*>{1,2}[[:space:]]*//'); if [ -z "$path" ]; then path=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE '\btee\b[^|;&]*' | tail -1 | awk '{for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if ($i !~ /^-/) {print $i; exit}}'); fi; if [ -z "$path" ]; then case "$cmd" in *cp\ *|*mv\ *) path=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -oE '\b(cp|mv)\b.*' | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}') ;; esac; fi; [ -z "$path" ] && exit 0; case "$path" in *"$target"*) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$path" in */*) d=$(cd "$(dirname "$path")" 2>/dev/null && pwd) ;; *) d=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && pwd) ;; esac; t=$(cd "$d" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$d" ] || [ "$d" != "$t" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"These reference docs live only at repo root (design.md, product-behavior.md, schema-spec.md) per CLAUDE.md. Edit the matching section in the root file instead of creating a new one here.\"}}"; fi; }
